bug_semantics: Horizon generates downloadable OpenRC bash scripts that interpolate the current Keystone project/tenant name into a double-quoted assignment (historically OS_TENANT_NAME, later also OS_PROJECT_NAME). Django HTML auto-escape does not neutralize `$`, and the dedicated shellfilter later escaped only `\` ` ' " — not `$` or `!`. A privileged actor can create a project whose name contains `$(cmd)` (Launchpad PoC: openstack project create 'hzn01-$(printf${IFS}...|base64${IFS}-d|sh)'). A victim who downloads the RC file from the API Access panel and sources it executes that command in their local shell (CWE-78). Exploit needs project-create (typically domain/admin) plus user interaction. CVE.org PUBLISHED this as CWE-78 affecting Horizon from 8.0.0 until 25.3.3/25.5.3/25.7.4; OpenStack VMT declined an OSSA (class D / OSSN-0097, OSSA status Won't Fix) and called it hardening against user error, but still shipped OSSN-0097 and merged a code fix. The CVE is not rejected or withdrawn.
flaw_origin: The first write of the project-name interpolation is a68d35e52f449c54c27c3e680a562d326a83479b (2012-03-30), which added tenant_name to the OpenRC render context and emitted `export OS_TENANT_NAME={{ tenant_name }}` in place of using tenant_id. The immediate parent still used `export OS_TENANT_NAME={{ tenant_id }}` and had no `{{ tenant_name }}` in any template. Later commits quoted the value (7b72245, 2012-06-28), added an incomplete shellfilter that never tested `$()` (53429da, 2013-08-02), and duplicated the same pattern as OS_PROJECT_NAME (7842c9f, 2015-03-06). Those are quoting/sanitizer/alias follow-ons, not a first write of the unsanitized name interpolation.
ai_marker: absent; author and committer Gabriel Hurley <gabriel@strikeawe.com> on 2012-03-30; commit object trailers are only Change-Id: Ie57e816ad7edfa0cb636a93413b8b7faf72f0d2d (no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, or bot identity)
evidence: CVE.org record CVE-2026-55748 state=PUBLISHED (not REJECTED/WITHDRAWN); description: OpenStack Horizon before 25.7.4 produces RC download scripts that may embed a crafted project name with shell metacharacters; CWE-78; NOTE that some parties consider this hardening rather than a vulnerability. GHSA-6wrm-x65g-hr4p withdrawn_at=null; range <= 25.7.3, first_patched_version null.

Vendor disposition LP#2152240: horizon Fix Released; ossa Won't Fix; ossn Fix Released as OSSN-0097. Jeremy Stanley classified it class D (social-engineering / hardening). A real CWE-78 remains when a user sources the generated script; the CVE was not withdrawn.

Attack path from LP#2152240: project name `hzn01-$(printf${IFS}dG91Y2ggdGVzdA==|base64${IFS}-d|sh)` becomes `export OS_PROJECT_NAME="hzn01-$(...)"` and executes on `source`. Reporter Tim Shephard; assigned Radomir Dopieralski.

Direct fix (single parent 1477abd588b9477d002344fcfca5b69b2fc4a88f): c7863093c67a554b527ddfb8b48fff7d37d140b5 author/committer Radomir Dopieralski, Gerrit 990661 Change-Id Iec01e820a7ff0d4d3bed7f8929cb9c3229deb502, Fixes-bug: 2152240. Adds `$` and `!` to horizon/templatetags/shellfilter.py replacements and applies |shellfilter plus double quotes to remaining OpenRC interpolations (OS_AUTH_URL, OS_PROJECT_ID, OS_INTERFACE, application-credential fields).

Pre-fix vulnerable line in api_access/openrc.sh.template: `export OS_PROJECT_NAME="{{ tenant_name|shellfilter }}"` with shellfilter omitting `$`. Application-credential template likewise left several values unfiltered.

BIC a68d35e52f449c54c27c3e680a562d326a83479b is a single-parent non-merge: forms.py starts passing tenant_name from the tenant-choice label; template changes `export OS_TENANT_NAME={{ tenant_id }}` to `export OS_TENANT_ID={{ tenant_id }}` plus `export OS_TENANT_NAME={{ tenant_name }}` (horizon/dashboards/settings/templates/settings/project/openrc.sh.template:15).

Parent-tree verification: git grep '{{ tenant_name' 1e8ba66fe4cac98ad840e60973e643d6eb35010c -- '*.template' '*.sh' has no matches. Parent template is `export OS_TENANT_NAME={{ tenant_id }}` only. Original 2011 RC generator 6388d3e7659454f31e8343c5fbacd69f882bf606 interpolated tenant_id/username, not tenant_name.

git log -S tenant_name -- '**/openrc.sh.template' first functional name interpolation is a68d35e; later hits are 7842c9f (OS_PROJECT_NAME alias of the same |shellfilter expression) and 46a7395 (v3 domain fields). 53429da44150b13987009577c12ebd7a711ef634 introduced shellfilter without `$`/`!`; its tests cover `o"; sudo rm -rf /` and backslashes, not `$()`.

Tag membership: a68d35e is not in 2012.1, is in 2012.2 and 8.0.0 (CVE start). 25.7.3 (0a4439556517cf67be0aa949b6551a14e409af75, 2026-05-02) contains the BIC and not the fix. c7863093 is on master and is an ancestor of tag 26.0.0 (2026-06-30); 25.3.3/25.5.3/25.7.4 tags were never cut. Stable backports: 4acf34f1a3326aa1c3a5b60c132b3fbf5c354092 (stable/2026.1), 4a4995f46f16a5ae3fb40fae528d896150ff27f3 (stable/2025.2), 933adb45c43ac5571f1f8d00526a673016f9b0a8 (stable/2025.1).
BIC commit object (`git cat-file -p a68d35e52f449c54c27c3e680a562d326a83479b`) has no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, or bot author/committer. AI-on-fix (2026) is irrelevant to BIC attribution.
reasoning: Vulnerability-first: sourcing Horizon's generated OpenRC file interpolates an attacker-chosen project name into a shell assignment. `$()` is live in double quotes; the 2013 shellfilter never escaped `$`, so the Launchpad PoC is command injection in the victim's shell after a privileged project-create plus download/source. CVE.org is PUBLISHED (not rejected). OpenStack's OSSA Won't Fix / OSSN-0097 class D note is a severity/taxonomy disagreement, not a withdrawn advisory, so this is a real vulnerability rather than FALSE_POSITIVE. BIC search started from the RC templates and tenant_name interpolation, not from AI-marked commits. The smallest first write is a68d35e (2012-03-30): parent still bound OS_TENANT_NAME to tenant_id and had no tenant_name template variable. Subsequent quoting, incomplete shellfilter, and OS_PROJECT_NAME duplication reuse that mechanism and are not BICs. Direct parent-tree grep confirms absence. That BIC is a human 2012 Gerrit commit by Gabriel Hurley with no commit-object AI markers, so the verdict is NOT_AI. The landing fix on master is c7863093 (Gerrit 990661), present in 26.0.0 and backported to stable/2025.1–2026.1; 25.7.3 remains unpatched as GHSA states.
